[RARC.5.4.7] The total order is a property of the agenda's
comparator, not of any per-rule annotation or pluggable
conflict-resolution strategy. Each activation carries its
rule's terminal ordinal and its creation timetag; the
comparator orders by **ordinal, then timetag** — exactly
[LDET.5.4] then [LDET.5.5]. The ordinal is unique per rule,
so it decides between any two rules on its own; the timetag
ascends with completion order and orders the activations of
one rule against each other.

**Refraction is not a key.** An activation whose (rule, token)
identity has already fired is suppressed when selected rather than
sorted later ([LDET.5.3]): the comparator never weighs whether an
activation fired.
